narrative: The same leaf. The light on it is lower. No candle is lit. The question is still the last line but one. Both hands on the chair, not on the paper. The leaf lies as it was. The leaf is still a full sheet, not creased down. The cloak is on the peg by the door.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Visible/present in Sat on while the light left the desk
